# Global PHP function names defined on every FPP /api/* request (www/api/index.php loads
# api/lib/limonade.php, config.php and common.php, plus every file those two include, then api/controllers/*.php).
# A plugin api.php declaring any of these is a redeclare fatal on FPP 9 and a skipped API on 10+.
# Generated from FalconChristmas/fpp 795efc47a (2026-09-22). To regenerate, in fpp/www:
#   incs=$(grep -hoE "(require|include)(_once)?\s*\(?\s*(__DIR__\s*\.\s*)?['\"][^'\"]+\.(php|inc)['\"]" config.php common.php | grep -oE "[^'\"/]+\.(php|inc)" | sort -u)
#   grep -rhoE '^\s*function\s+[A-Za-z_]\w*' api/lib/limonade.php config.php common.php $incs api/controllers/*.php 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/^\s*function\s+//' | sort -uf
